replaces: rules/skills.json (52-skill first draft remains for comparison)
notes: One and only one rated attack skill for each attack and one chosen defensive skill for each incoming attack.
Historic specialty skills map by actual technique/weapon, not by their original label.
Language fluencies become separate learned credentials or specializations, not nine additive ECL skills.
Medium armor receives a classification per armor model (light or heavy), never double credit.
These original perk hooks do not have implemented actions or costs; passive defenses need their own breakthrough rule.

skills.name: One-Handed
skills.description: One-hand weapons: swords, daggers, axes, maces, and one-handed spears.

perks.name: Ready Grip
perks.summary: Draw or shift grip without abandoning a useful action.

perks.name: Flowing Strike
perks.summary: Reposition after landing a one-handed hit.

skills.name: Two-Handed
skills.description: Weapons and polearms used with two hands; not limited to swords.

perks.name: Braced Swing
perks.summary: Maintain control when a foe attempts to disrupt a committed swing.

perks.name: Sweeping Arc
perks.summary: Challenge a second nearby foe after a decisive strike.

skills.name: Archery
skills.description: Bows, crossbows, and other mundane ranged projectile skill (throwing as a specialty).

perks.name: Steady Draw
perks.summary: Reduce aim disruption caused by a modest movement.

perks.name: Called Flight
perks.summary: Take a deliberate precision shot against partial cover.

skills.name: Block
skills.description: Shield positioning, weapon parries, interposition, and guarded maneuvers.

perks.name: Shield Wall
perks.summary: Protect an adjacent ally with a well-positioned shield.

perks.name: Turn the Blow
perks.summary: Convert an especially good block into repositioning.

skills.name: Heavy Armor
skills.description: Mobility and effective interception using rigid/heavy armor; some medium suits.

perks.name: Load Bearing
perks.summary: Reduce armor-related encumbrance penalties.

perks.name: Iron Stance
perks.summary: Avoid involuntary movement when braced in heavy armor.

skills.name: Unarmed
skills.description: Punching, kicking, clinching, grappling, and other hand-to-hand fighting.

perks.name: Grappler's Poise
perks.summary: Control position while a grappler attempts an escape.

perks.name: Unarmed Counter
perks.summary: Exploit a foe who overcommits in close combat.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Climbing, jumping, running, swimming and sustained physical exertion.

perks.name: Enduring Pace
perks.summary: Sustain exertion through a long journey.

perks.name: Burst of Effort
perks.summary: Push through strenuous movement in an urgent scene.

skills.name: Smithing
skills.description: Crafting, tuning, maintaining and repairing mundane arms, tools and armor.

perks.name: Tempered Edge
perks.summary: Produce a reliably hardened mundane blade.

perks.name: Masterwork Forge
perks.summary: Craft sophisticated designs from suitable materials.

skills.name: Alteration
skills.description: Changing physical properties and constraints with magic.

perks.name: Measured Change
perks.summary: Tune a minor alteration effect more precisely.

perks.name: Adaptive Pattern
perks.summary: Adjust an ongoing alteration within its approved parameters.

skills.name: Conjuration
skills.description: Summoning, bindings, and external beings.

perks.name: Stable Summons
perks.summary: Maintain order when an entity answers a summons.

perks.name: Binding Circle
perks.summary: Improve safety and control in a negotiated summoning.

skills.name: Destruction
skills.description: Harmful and elemental magical effects.

perks.name: Elemental Shaping
perks.summary: Avoid incidental damage while aiming a destructive spell.

perks.name: Focused Ruin
perks.summary: Concentrate power against a narrow target.

skills.name: Illusion
skills.description: Perception, influence and magical deception.

perks.name: Subtle Glamour
perks.summary: Mask a small tell within an illusion.

perks.name: Layered Misdirection
perks.summary: Maintain a believable deception under scrutiny.

skills.name: Mysticism
skills.description: Souls, magical detection, unusual movement and legacy Thaumaturgy effects.

perks.name: Soul Perception
perks.summary: Notice disturbances in soul-affecting enchantments.

perks.name: Arcane Thread
perks.summary: Trace lingering magical relationships between objects.

skills.name: Restoration
skills.description: Magical recovery, restoration, warding and support.

perks.name: Precise Mending
perks.summary: Control a healing effect around a delicate injury.

perks.name: Steady Renewal
perks.summary: Sustain restorative work in a difficult scene.

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.description: Study and extraction of properties of material reagents, potions and poisons.

perks.name: Reagent Insight
perks.summary: Infer likely effects of an unfamiliar ingredient.

perks.name: Careful Extraction
perks.summary: Separate valuable properties from a difficult mixture.

skills.name: Enchanting
skills.description: Binding lasting supernatural effects into items.

perks.name: Stable Imprint
perks.summary: Reduce risk of losing an enchantment during a delicate step.

perks.name: Soulwright
perks.summary: Control sophisticated soul-powered equipment.

skills.name: Light Armor
skills.description: Wearing flexible light and designated light-medium armor effectively.

perks.name: Silent Fit
perks.summary: Reduce the audible interference of worn armor.

perks.name: Quick Slip
perks.summary: Escapingly reposition while lightly protected.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.description: Active evasions, tumbling, falls and unarmored defense.

perks.name: Soft Landing
perks.summary: Use agility and positioning to absorb a controlled fall.

perks.name: Unfettered Step
perks.summary: Escape a constrained position with precise footwork.

skills.name: Sneak
skills.description: Concealment, movement unseen and setting up ambushes.

perks.name: Shadow Passage
perks.summary: Cross short exposed stretches between hiding places.

perks.name: Ghost Trail
perks.summary: Leave fewer traces of covert passage.

skills.name: Security
skills.description: Locks, traps, alarms and mechanical bypasses.

perks.name: Trap Sense
perks.summary: Identify a likely trigger before interacting with a device.

perks.name: Clean Disarm
perks.summary: Disable a complex mechanism while preserving evidence.

skills.name: Legerdemain
skills.description: Pickpocketing, palming, substitutions and other unobtrusive manipulation.

perks.name: Light Fingers
perks.summary: Conceal a small manipulation in an ordinary exchange.

perks.name: Invisible Exchange
perks.summary: Swap or plant an object while attention is elsewhere.

skills.name: Speechcraft
skills.description: Persuasion, trade, etiquette, social networks and streetwise dealings.

perks.name: Read the Room
perks.summary: Notice a listener's immediate priorities.

perks.name: Careful Appeal
perks.summary: Tailor a consequential argument to an audience.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Wilderness skills, navigation, observation, basic mundane medicine and field triage.

perks.name: Triage
perks.summary: Identify the most dangerous injuries in a challenging scene.

perks.name: Field Surgeon
perks.summary: Stabilize a difficult injury without magical help.

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: Research, history, cultures, investigation and specialized scholarly knowledge; not universal fluency.

perks.name: Focused Research
perks.summary: Locate reliable material in an unfamiliar archive.

perks.name: Scholar's Insight
perks.summary: Connect apparently unrelated credible clues from a specialized field.
